name: buildx-studio
description: BuildX AI Studio Pro — browser video editor (web), API and FFmpeg render workers.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p apps/api && tsc -p apps/worker && tsc -p apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @studio/core && npm run build -w @studio/api && npm run build -w @studio/worker && npm run build -w @studio/web
